title: Bus sniffer
subtitle: Raw adapter monitor (ATMA) — live polling pauses while sniffing
notePlaceholder: What is happening? e.g. VCDS Group 121 basic settings, engine idle
unavailableTitle: Bus monitoring is not available over this adapter link.
unavailableBody: Classic Bluetooth adapters hand over each reply only when the adapter’s “>” prompt arrives, and the bus monitor streams without one. Use a Bluetooth LE or Wi-Fi adapter to sniff the bus; every other screen works over this adapter.
reconnect: Not connected — reconnect to start a new run.
droppedNote: (the oldest lines were discarded to keep memory bounded)
stopToShare: Stop the monitor to share the capture.
shareHelp: CSV has one row per frame (time since start, CAN id, byte count, bytes); raw is every adapter line exactly as printed. The file carries the car, adapter and note as they were at Start.
help: Streams every frame the adapter hears (headers on). On K-line cars you will mostly see the periodic keep-alives; on CAN this is the live bus grouped by arbitration id. Every line is kept (up to 20 000) so the run can be shared after Stop.
